## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## Unreleased`
- [ ] Guides (`README.md`, `docs/guide/`) are updated if users see the change
- [ ] `docs/how-it-works.md` is updated if `kit/` or `installer/` changed
- [ ] No stack-, framework- or role-specific behaviour
